name: tree-sitter-sysml
description: KerML and SysML v2 grammars for tree-sitter
author: Open-MBEE

scripts.generate: cd kerml && tree-sitter generate && cd ../sysml && tree-sitter generate
scripts.build: cd kerml && tree-sitter build -o kerml.so && cd ../sysml && tree-sitter build -o sysml.so
scripts.test: cd kerml && tree-sitter test && cd ../sysml && tree-sitter test
